sections.title: Market Pulse: Stocks Rebound as Bond Market Stabilizes

items.headline: U.S. Stocks Attempt Recovery After Volatile Week
items.summary: U.S. equities are showing gains today, trimming losses from a shaky week as Treasury yields stabilize and oil prices remain largely unchanged. Major indices are rebounding after a sharp sell-off in the previous session, though they remain on track for overall weekly declines. Market sentiment is cautiously optimistic as investors assess recent economic data and upcoming Federal Reserve cues.

items.headline: Moderna Soars on Vaccine Trial Success
items.summary: Moderna shares surged following positive Phase 3 results for its personalized mRNA cancer vaccine, developed in collaboration with Merck.

items.headline: Evolution Metals & Technologies Corp. Jumps on Earnings Beat
items.summary: Evolution Metals & Technologies Corp. saw its shares climb after reporting second-quarter losses that beat analyst consensus estimates.

items.headline: Robinhood Rallies with Bitcoin Surge
items.summary: Shares of Robinhood Markets rallied as Bitcoin prices experienced a significant rebound.

items.headline: Ross Stores Exceeds Q2 Expectations
items.summary: Ross Stores gained after the off-price retailer posted better-than-expected second-quarter results, driven by new customer acquisition and tariff refunds.

items.headline: Hut 8 Corp. Leads Decliners
items.summary: Hut 8 Corp. experienced a notable drop today.

items.headline: Ubiquiti Inc. Falls After Q4 Report
items.summary: Ubiquiti Inc. shares declined following the release of its fourth-quarter earnings results.

items.headline: Marvell Technology Down on Profit-Taking
items.summary: Marvell Technology shares fell, largely attributed to institutional profit-taking and strategic risk reduction ahead of its upcoming earnings report.

items.headline: Materials Lead, Information Technology Lags in Sector Performance
items.summary: Materials shares jumped by 2.3% today, leading sector performance, while information technology stocks fell by 0.5%. Broadly, health care and financials also showed advances in the S&P 500.

items.headline: Fed Officials See Potential for Further Rate Hikes Amid Inflation Concerns
items.summary: Minutes from the Federal Reserve's July 28-29 meeting indicate that many officials believe higher interest rates may be necessary in the coming months if inflation does not subside. This comes as the US S&P Global composite PMI for August climbed to 56, marking the strongest growth since April 2022.

items.headline: Treasury Increases Debt Buybacks to Stabilize Yields
items.summary: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced an increase in long-term debt buybacks, doubling the size of operations from $2 billion to at least $4 billion, in an effort to prod yields lower and enhance liquidity.

items.headline: BJ's Wholesale Club Beats Estimates; Nvidia Earnings on Deck
items.summary: BJ's Wholesale Club ($BJ) posted stronger-than-expected second-quarter results, beating both top and bottom-line estimates. Meanwhile, investors are keenly awaiting NVIDIA's ($NVDA) earnings report, scheduled for next Wednesday, which is expected to significantly influence the technology sector.

items.headline: Bitcoin Rally Boosts Crypto Stocks; Oil Prices Remain Elevated
items.summary: A notable rally in Bitcoin prices provided a significant boost to cryptocurrency-related stocks. Concurrently, elevated 10-year Treasury yields, near 4.69%, and rising oil prices, with Brent crude near $93 and WTI near $86 a barrel, continue to be key macro factors influenced by ongoing Middle East tensions.
